prompts.slate: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless albedo texture for an existing realistic Godot game set in Antwerp in autumn 1873. Create a high-resolution square 2048 x 2048 texture of weathered blue-grey Ardennes roof slate. Orthographic straight-on surface scan, edge to edge, exactly eight horizontal courses of small rectangular slates, staggered half-tile running bond with eight slates across each row. Restrained charcoal, blue-grey and occasional muted warm mineral variation, extremely fine sedimentary grain, subtle chipped lower edges and sparse small pale lichen flecks. All slate faces retain coherent flat planes. Uniform diffuse neutral light, no directional illumination, no cast shadows, no perspective, no objects, no text or borders. Horizontal and vertical edges must tile seamlessly: periodic half-tile bond, no large stains or standout damage. The overlap is only a narrow dark line. Dry base color, no baked glossy highlights. Real photographic mineral detail at millimetre scale, no illustration or stylization.
prompts.iron: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square 2048x2048 albedo material for iron objects in Antwerp 1873. Orthographic macro surface scan of old black-painted forged iron. Fine compact grey-black metal texture, sparse shallow pinprick pits, restrained very dark brown oxidation, tiny subdued rusty abrasions occupying less than ten percent of the surface. No large peeling paint flakes, no chunky corrosion, no bolts, no panel edges, no symbols. Visually near-uniform at distance, rich but fine irregular detail up close. Flat diffuse illumination, absolutely no directional shading, highlights or vignette. Seamless periodic edges in both axes. Whole image is one continuous flat material, no background. Muted charcoal, no orange patches. Photographic, physically credible millimetre-scale texture.
prompts.brick: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless high resolution albedo texture for Belgian town walls in Antwerp 1873. Square 2048x2048 orthographic surface scan, full frame old hand-made red-brown Flemish brick, running bond, exactly eight horizontal courses and four whole bricks per course, staggered half brick alternate courses. Thin recessed buff-grey lime mortar, slightly worn arrises, fine porous fired clay and subtle soot. Restrained burnt umber and dusty red, no saturated orange, no large white mineral streaks, no moss blobs, no perspective, no illumination gradient, no cast shadows or specular highlights. Repeat edges seamlessly both axes with complete periodic masonry pattern. Bricks roughly twice as long as tall. Flat neutral diffuse lighting. Crisp photographic fine material detail, no text, border or extraneous objects.
prompts.poster: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: flat portrait 1024x1536 shop advertisement texture for a chandler interior in Antwerp 1873. Entire canvas is the printed poster, no mockup wall, no perspective. Old muted indigo-blue ink and slightly yellowed cream rag paper, sober Belgian letterpress broadside with a thin double-rule rectangular border, readable antique serif capital typography, small central woodcut of three tallow candles and a plain oil flask. Text verbatim, neatly stacked with generous margins: "KAARSEN" then "OLIE EN ZEEP" then "GOEDE WAER" then "AAN BILLIJKEN PRIJS". No other words, dates or numbers. Fine paper fibres, restrained handling wear and faint pale stains, flat even illumination. Crisp correct lettering, no nonsense text, no modern design, no glossy paper. Light wear must not obscure letters.
prompts.roof-atlas: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached low-resolution four-quadrant roof texture atlas from a Godot game, not a composition reference. Rebuild it with crisp photographic material detail at 2048x2048. Preserve EXACT layout and quadrant boundaries at x=50%, y=50%, all four cells edge to edge, no gutters. TOP LEFT: muted old red clay roof tiles in the same staggered courses and number of rows as original. TOP RIGHT: grey-blue Ardennes slate in same staggered courses and number of rows as original. BOTTOM LEFT: flat old matte grey lead roofing with the same straight vertical rolled seams as the original. BOTTOM RIGHT: very dark fine-grained weathered bituminous flat roof surface with no new objects. Antwerp 1873, realistic muted aged mineral materials, extremely fine grain, restrained wear. Preserve original base hues and overall brightness; no modern objects. Each individual quadrant must tile perfectly with ITSELF, not across its adjacent quadrant. Flat neutral diffuse lighting, no dramatic shadows, perspective or highlights. Do not move any boundaries or redesign the atlas. No text.
prompts.debris-atlas: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is a tightly packed game material texture atlas, 256x128. Repaint at 2048x1024 with photographic fine-grained detail while preserving EXACTLY every original rectangular region, its relative dimensions, boundary coordinates, dominant color, and semantic material. These cells wrap modeled street debris in Antwerp 1873: dark dung and straw, tawny straw, muted green vegetation, grey and brown grit, worn horizontal wood, paper, charcoal, brick fragments, dark bottle glass, shell, old sackcloth. Do not turn this into a photograph of loose objects; each cell stays a flat close surface texture, with no perspective, no cast shadows, no border. DO NOT rearrange cells, add gutters, invent shapes, shift boundaries or place whole objects over adjacent cells. Unused dark cells remain dark. Retain material grain direction and existing alpha if any. Restrained realistic colors, no bright new patch, no readable text. Sharp fine material detail, not painted blobs.
prompts.slate-v2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this roof slate albedo texture, preserving its six columns and eight courses and staggered half-width joints. Correct review defects: make each slate a THIN split sheet about 4mm thick, not a stone paving block. Entire faces are flat smooth cleaved blue-grey slate with delicate parallel mineral lamination; remove the crumpled/hammered texture. Remove ALL bright lower-edge bevel highlights and the broad black shadows beneath courses; keep only hairline joints and very subtle dark overlap lines without directional shadows. Flatten lighting completely to a diffuse albedo scan. Remove all large bright circular lichen spots and reduce remaining lichen to tiny subdued grey flecks nearly invisible at a distance. Keep realistic photographic fine grain and muted grey-blue color. No shiny surface, no thick rounded edges, no deep gaps. Strict periodic tiling on all four edges, no border or vignette. Square highest resolution, intended 2048x2048.
prompts.wall-brick-v2: Use case: precise-object-edit. Rebuild this game city wall texture with photographic detail at highest resolution. It tiles over an existing 1.84m by1.56m wall UV area and must not move joint positions. Antwerp 1873 Boom brick, narrow dark red-brown handmade clay with fine gritty clay pores and subtly irregular edges, muted soot-darkened red and umber, buff-grey recessed lime mortar. Real masonry flat albedo scan, no directional lighting, no thick rounded bricks, no sandy raised mortar, no strong white edge highlights, no exaggerated cracks, no isolated very dark brick that repeats conspicuously. Remove computer-painted pixel noise and replace with natural fine clay grain. Even overall color and brightness; periodic edges tile precisely. No border, text, moss or shadow gradients.
prompts.iron-v2: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Seamless square 2048x2048 flat albedo surface scan for old painted iron railings and hinges in an Antwerp1873 game. NOT concrete, not asphalt, no gravel pores.
